pages.text: $(italic)Formerly living. Undead mechanics apply. The pack's most punishing race in daylight, most powerful at night.$()$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Dark Power$() — +20% damage dealt between 8pm and 4am (in-game time). Stacks with class bonuses.$(br2)$(bold)Night Vision$() — Permanent night vision. No visual difference from $(thing)Human$() during the day.$(br2)$(bold)Sunlight Weakness$() — Direct sunlight: burn effect like a zombie. Helmets and shade prevent this. Plan around it.$(br2)$(bold)Healing Penalty$() — Natural regen and most healing potions 30% less effective. Life Steal and $(thing)Paladin$() auras unaffected.
